facts.goal: Controlled deterministic readiness test: trigger one Jump, read navigation readiness, request one short navigation and verify its actual outcome; do not automatically retry. This is an artificial fixture, not autonomous natural survival.

coverage.note: VisibleBlockTotal counts only observed non-air cells inside the bounded scan, not hidden world contents. OmittedBlocks is output truncation; incomplete scans may contain additional unknown cells. Entity/pickable truncation signals additional sensed results, not their total count. Pickable sense distinguishes vision and proximity. Position is an actual visible sample; Face may be unknown. Action reach and native prerequisites still apply.

navigation.completion_meaning: Arrived requires the observed local route and settled completion; failed navigation may still have made partial progress. Path is traveled distance, Remaining is endpoint distance.

facts.host: Host supplies actual state and terminal statuses. Queries are bounded projections; omitted results are not facts. Use fresh named tools only.

manual.note: Static public item labels, not possessions or a plan. Native recipe and storage queries provide actual requirements and slot roles.

offers.Name: read_environment
offers.Description: Read local light, weather and time.

offers.Name: read_storage
offers.Description: Read actual slots and crafting preview or furnace heat/fuel/progress. Furnaces process matching ingredients with sufficient native heat/fuel over time, not act_Craft.

offers.Name: read_map
offers.Description: Read historical positions with lastSeenGameTime. Only navigation, not evidence of current resources. Page offsets use mutable live LRU order; re-observe after arrival.

offers.Name: read_item
offers.Description: Read the entry for a known item.

offers.Name: find_items
offers.Description: Search items you know about.

offers.Name: find_creatures
offers.Description: Search creatures you know about.

offers.Name: find_recipes
offers.Description: Read recipe knowledge: materials, grid/station and heat requirements. Recipe existence does not mean supplies or a usable station exist.

offers.Name: act_MoveTo
offers.Description: Move to an observed or remembered location, or explore with bearing and distance.

offers.Name: act_FaceTowards
offers.Description: Aim at a currently observed location, or turn by relative bearing with optional head pitch.

offers.Name: act_Jump
offers.Description: Jump once using native locomotion.

offers.Name: act_Wait
offers.Description: Wait for game time to pass.

offers.Name: act_Eat
offers.Description: Consume food from an owned inventory slot.

offers.Name: act_Sleep
offers.Description: Try to fall asleep at the current place.

offers.Name: act_WakeUp
offers.Description: Wake up.

offers.Name: act_SelectItem
offers.Description: Select a held inventory slot.

offers.Name: act_TransferItems
offers.Description: Move existing items. source_value is source slot CURRENT value; destination_value is destination slot CURRENT value (0 if empty), not the transferred item.

offers.Name: act_Dig
offers.Description: Dig the observed block.

offers.Name: act_Place
offers.Description: Place the held block against an observed face.

offers.Name: act_Craft
offers.Description: Collect result from an already correctly arranged crafting grid. Does not fill ingredients. Grid crafting cannot heat/cook food.

offers.Name: host_navigate_local
offers.Description: Bounded local navigation 1-4m. Absolute world bearing: 0=+Z, 90=+X. Does not promise arrival; inspect actual status.

offers.Name: host_navigation_status
offers.Description: Read the current bounded navigation request and actual status, including stopping.
